title: Encrypted backup and fresh-store restore
description: Spec §10. scrypt-derived passphrase key, authenticated KDF header, bounded parameters, restore only into an empty store with a fresh vault key, bindings cleared and grants/approvals inactive.

acceptanceCriteria.text: T20: restore works with only the backup and passphrase; wrong passphrase, corruption, hostile KDF parameters and oversized backups fail safely
T21: restore uses a fresh key and leaves bindings absent and grants/approvals inactive pending review

plan: 2. Domain: the backup container (v1: scrypt N=131072, r=8, p=1, 32-byte salt, 32-byte key, AES-256-GCM with a fresh nonce; format and KDF parameters authenticated) with bounded sizes and parameters refused before any allocation; unit tests.

3. Application: runBackup and runRestore over a passphrase port and a backup-file port. Restore refuses any non-empty destination, generates a fresh vault key and id, preserves project records, and clears local bindings (approvals and grants do not exist in the state model yet; the obligation is recorded for WCLI-9/WCLI-12).

4. Adapters: hidden-input terminal passphrase reader (echo suppressed via raw mode, bounded, confirmation on create) and the backup file (created mode 0600 with O_EXCL and no overwrite, read bounded).
5. CLI and contract: ward backup --output <path>, ward restore --input <path>, manifest entries, error catalog additions, contract tests.

6. Tests: T20 six ways (round-trip with only the backup and passphrase; wrong passphrase; corruption; hostile KDF parameters; oversized backup; missing terminal) and T21 (fresh key and id, bindings absent), each measured against the pre-change state where applicable.
7. ADR 0006 recording the container format and the restore authority rules; docs sync and lore check --strict exit 0.
8. bun run check green, independent review dispatched over the diff, findings fixed, criteria checked on the branch, PR merged, dev promoted to main.
implementationNotes: HANDOFF AT THE RECYCLE BOUNDARY (2026-09-28, opum-agent renewed this session for budget; not a decision stop). REACHABILITY: this note is on the branch by its own commit, so the whole record is on feat/WCLI-13-encrypted-backup-restore; PR opum-ai/ward-cli#32 is OPEN and NOT merged. STATE: the feature is implemented and green. src/domain/backup.ts (the v1 container: scrypt N=131072/r=8/p=1 with a fresh 32-byte salt, AES-256-GCM with a fresh nonce, the domain, format version, origin vault id, revision and every KDF parameter authenticated as header data; a parameter set is matched exactly and refused by name BEFORE any derivation allocates for it), src/application/backup.ts (runBackup and runRestore over a PassphraseSource port and a BackupFiles port; restore refuses any non-empty destination first, verifies and decodes the whole backup before creating anything, mints a fresh vault id and key with the key stored before the vault so an interrupted restore leaves at most an orphan key, keeps the project records and rebuilds the state with localBindings emptied), src/adapters/backup-file.ts (O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW at mode 0600, never replaces, removes a partial file on failure, bounded reads that refuse non-regular files), src/adapters/passphrase.ts (raw-mode read so nothing echoes, no mask because a mask discloses length, confirmation on create, bounded, terminal restored on every path, no argument/environment/pipe path anywhere), the CLI commands ward backup --output and ward restore --input with their manifest entries and the missing_required_option code, and ADR 0006. EVIDENCE IN HAND: bun run check green (337 tests, 0 fail, no lint or format findings); test/backup.test.ts (9 cases: round trip into a machine that shares nothing, wrong passphrase, changed bytes in ciphertext/header/parameters, hostile N=2 and N=2^30 refused as unsupported within an elapsed bound, oversized, no terminal without a credential-store read, existing file never replaced, no vault, restore into an existing vault leaving key and vault untouched) and test/passphrase.test.ts (6 cases, the raw-mode sequence on every path); lore validate --strict, lore check --strict and lore agents --check exit 0 after the ADR 0006 summary was shortened to satisfy the frontmatter-length rule; docs/adr/index.md and docs/log.md were regenerated by lore sync and committed WITH the ADR, which is what WCLI-28 made possible. WHAT REMAINS, in order: (1) dispatch an independent opum-workflow:reviewer over b1f4cb7 as spec section 15 requires (crypto use, error paths, authority checks, the keychain boundary) and fix its findings; (2) check T20 and T21 against the tests as evidence and add the closing summary citing PR #32 and the head run id, on the branch, before merging; (3) confirm #32 own run is green on its head, squash merge with a bare gh pr merge, delete the local branch; (4) promote dev to main (ordinary delivery) and report origin/main by ref. ALSO OPEN: the structural key-creation invariant in test/setup.test.ts now names two callers (setup and restore) with its reasoning and an explicit statement of what it cannot prove; the behavioural half is in test/backup.test.ts. KNOWN LIMITS NOT CHECKED, stated rather than implied: the real terminal passphrase read needs a tty (the adapter test injects bytes through the same seam), the packaged binary was not smoke-tested for these commands, and Linux/Windows are untouched. RAILS for whoever continues: every test uses temporary ward directories, MemoryKeychain and an in-process passphrase; never run ward backup or ward restore against the real ~/.ward or the real Keychain.
